title: Expanded geographic hierarchy and smarter multilingual question answering
body:
- Enhanced geographic question answering with automatic regional hierarchy expansion: countries in the Arabian Peninsula, Levant, and Persian Gulf now seamlessly answer Middle East questions, and countries across North and South America answer questions about the Americas.
- Added full support for English organization names and alliance variations, including European Union, United Nations, G7, G20, and the Schengen zone.
- Improved currency question understanding for the US dollar and Euro, along with colloquial and informal equator queries (e.g. "Below equator?", "Above the equator?").
- Added support for nation population queries with inhabitants and citizens, and text pattern questions on country names (e.g. "ends with stan").
- Disambiguated official and co-official languages from general spoken language inquiries, ensuring accurate local answers for multi-language nations (like Spain, Canada, Finland, and Switzerland) without false negatives for widely spoken minority languages.
- Your saved game progress, streaks, and question and guess limits are unchanged.
